name: Nibbit

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Fixed order, repeating.

threat: Solo: Butt lands on turns 1, 4, 7 — each one after a Hiss is 2 damage bigger.
Pair: the two are offset, so one of them is always attacking.

name: Leaf Slime (S)

moves.name: Goop
moves.text: Shuffles 1 Slimed into your discard pile

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Random each turn.
Never the same move twice in a row.

scaling: None, but Slimed cards clog your deck.
threat: Low damage; the cost is the Slimed cards added to your deck for the fight.

name: Leaf Slime (M)

moves.name: Sticky Shot
moves.text: Shuffles 2 Slimed into your discard pile

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Opens with Sticky Shot, then alternates.

threat: 2 Slimed every other turn: longer fights mean more dead draws.

name: Twig Slime (S)

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Tackle every turn.

threat: Low HP; dies to almost any attack.

name: Twig Slime (M)

moves.name: Sticky Shot
moves.text: Shuffles 1 Slimed into your discard pile

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Opens with Sticky Shot.
Then random: Chomp 67%, Sticky Shot 33%.
Never Sticky Shot twice in a row.

threat: Hits harder than its size suggests (11) on most turns after turn 1.

name: Shrinker Beetle

powers.name: Shrink (on you)
powers.text: Your Attacks deal 30% less damage. Removed when the Beetle dies.

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Opens with Shrinker, then alternates Chomp / Stomp.

threat: Shrink cuts your attack damage by 30% until it dies — including against its partner in Overgrowth Crawlers.

general: In Overgrowth Crawlers, killing the Beetle first removes Shrink for the rest of the fight.
silent: Poison is not an Attack, so Shrink does not reduce it.
defect: Orb damage is not an Attack, so Shrink does not reduce it.
necrobinder: Doom is not an Attack, so Shrink should not reduce it (not checked).

name: Fuzzy Wurm Crawler

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Fixed 3-turn cycle: Goop, Inhale, Goop — so Goop twice in a row across cycles.

threat: Harmless early, dangerous if the fight drags past turn 5.

name: Inklet

powers.name: Slippery 1
powers.text: The next time it loses HP, it only loses 1 HP instead.

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Always 3 Inklets.
Outer two open with Jab; middle opens with Whirlwind.
Then alternates: Jab, then a 50/50 of Piercing Gaze or Whirlwind.

threat: Slippery wastes your first hit on each Inklet, so a single big attack is poor value.

general: A cheap hit first strips Slippery; save the bigger hit for after.
regent: A single Sovereign Blade hit only removes Slippery; open with something small.

name: Flyconid

phases.name: Turn 1
rules: Never opens with Weakening Spores.

phases.name: Turn 2 onward
rules: Never the same move twice in a row.

scaling: None; it makes its partner hit harder via Vulnerable.
threat: Note: the wiki names the move 'Weakening Spores' but lists its effect as 2 Vulnerable. Check the in-game intent.
checkNote: Weakening Spores effect (Vulnerable vs Weak) looks inconsistent on the wiki.

name: Snapping Jaxfruit

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Energy Orb every turn.

threat: Low HP but scales every turn; its partner is the bigger immediate hitter.

name: Fogmog

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Opens: Illusory Spores, then Thwack.
Then random: Thwack 40%, Headbutt 60%. Never the same move twice.
After a random Thwack → always Headbutt. After Headbutt → always Thwack, then back to random.

threat: The Eye revives every turn — killing it only buys one turn without Dazed.

general: The Eye has 6 HP and revives next turn; damage on Fogmog itself ends the fight.

name: Eye With Teeth

powers.name: Illusion
powers.text: When this dies, it revives next turn at full HP.

moves.name: Distract
moves.text: Shuffles 3 Dazed into your discard pile

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Distract every turn.

threat: 3 Dazed a turn adds up quickly in a long fight.

name: Mawler

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Opens with Claw.
Then random, equal chance. Never the same move twice.
Roar only once per fight.

scaling: None, but Roar makes Rip and Tear hit for 21 while Vulnerable.
threat: Unpredictable. After Roar, a Rip and Tear on you is the big hit to block.

name: Slithering Strangler

powers.name: Constrict (on you)
powers.text: While the Strangler is alive, take X damage at the end of your turn.

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Opens with Constrict.
Then: random Thwack or Lash (50/50, can repeat), then Constrict again, and so on.
So Constrict lands every other turn: turns 1, 3, 5…

scaling: +3 Constrict every other turn (if Constrict stacks — not confirmed).
threat: End-of-turn damage you cannot block the normal way while it lives.

general: Constrict ends when the Strangler dies — it is usually the priority target.

name: Vine Shambler

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Fixed order, repeating.

threat: Tangled makes playing cards cost more (the wiki suggests Attacks; check the tooltip). Chomp (16) follows the Tangled turn.

silent: The wiki notes non-Attack damage such as Deadly Poison gets around Tangled.
ironclad: The wiki notes non-Attack damage such as Inferno gets around Tangled.
defect: Orb damage is not an Attack card, so Tangled should not affect it.

checkNote: Exact Tangled wording not found on the wiki.

name: Cubex Construct

powers.name: Artifact 1
powers.text: Negates the next debuff applied to it.

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Opens with Charge Up, then Repeater, Repeater, Expel, repeating.

scaling: +2 Strength on turn 1 and every Repeater Blast: about +4 per 3-turn cycle.
threat: A race. Its first debuff is blocked by Artifact.

name: Axe Raider

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Fixed order, repeating.

threat: Big Swing every third turn (turns 3, 6, 9).

name: Assassin Raider

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Killshot every turn.

threat: Most damage per turn for its HP among the raiders.

name: Brute Raider

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Alternates, starting with Beat.

threat: Highest HP raider and the only one that scales.

name: Crossbow Raider

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Alternates, starting with Reload.

threat: 14 on turns 2, 4, 6. Killing it on turn 1 removes the first big hit.

name: Tracker Raider

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Opens with Track, then Unleash the Hounds every turn.

scaling: Each Strength it gains adds 8 damage (8 hits).
threat: Many small hits: Thorns-style effects punish it; flat damage reduction helps a lot.

name: Wriggler

moves.name: Wriggle
moves.text: Shuffles 1 Infection into your discard pile, gains 2 Strength

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Alternates.
Odd-numbered Wrigglers start with Nasty Bite; even-numbered with Wriggle.
From Phrog Parasite: spawn stunned and do nothing on their first turn.
Dense Vegetation event: start awake.

threat: Four at once; each adds Infection.

name: Bygone Effigy

powers.name: Slow
powers.text: Whenever you play a card, it takes 10% more damage from Attacks this turn.

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Turn 1 Sleep, turn 2 Wake, then Slashes every turn.

threat: Two free turns, then 23 damage every turn from turn 3.
Slow rewards playing many cards in a turn before your big Attack. Rounds down.

general: The damage you do on turns 1–2 decides the fight.
silent: Cheap cards and Shivs stack Slow fast. Poison does not benefit from Slow.
defect: Orb damage does not benefit from Slow (not an Attack).
necrobinder: Doom does not benefit from Slow (not an Attack).

name: Byrdonis

powers.name: Territorial 1
powers.text: At the end of its turn, gains 1 Strength.

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Alternates, starting with Swoop.
Wiki wording is ambiguous ("Swoop → Peck → Swoop") — confirm in game.

scaling: +1 Strength every turn. Peck gains 3 damage per Strength (3 hits).
threat: Pure race: attacks every turn and gets stronger every turn.

name: Phrog Parasite

powers.name: Infested
powers.text: On death, summons 4 Wrigglers. They spawn stunned and do nothing on their first turn.

moves.name: Infect
moves.text: Shuffles 3 Infection into your discard pile

phases.name: Phrog alive
rules: Alternates, starting with Infect.
When it dies, 4 Wrigglers appear (see Wriggler).

scaling: None itself; the Wrigglers gain Strength.
threat: Two fights in one: killing the Phrog starts a 4-enemy fight.
Infection (unplayable): take 3 damage at end of turn if it is in your hand.

general: Area damage is worth more here than anywhere else in the act.
The Wrigglers' stunned turn is a free turn to set up.
ironclad: Exhaust removes Infection permanently for the fight.
silent: Discard moves Infection out of your hand before end of turn.

name: Ceremonial Beast

powers.name: Plow (after Stamp)
powers.text: When its HP drops to 150 (160 at A9), it is Stunned and loses all Strength.

phases.name: Phase 1
rules: Turn 1 Stamp, then Plow every turn.

phases.name: Phase 2 (HP ≤ 150)
phases.trigger: HP drops to the Plow threshold
rules: Stunned (loses all Strength), then Beast Cry, Stomp, Crush, repeating.

scaling: Phase 1: +2 Strength per Plow (18, 20, 22…). Phase 2: +3 Strength per Crush.
threat: You need 102 damage (252 → 150) to trigger the stun; the longer that takes, the harder Plow hits.
Crossing the threshold resets its Strength and gives a free turn.

general: Ringing: effect not confirmed from the wiki — check the tooltip.
regent: Big single hits are good for crossing the 150 threshold on your terms.

name: The Kin (Kin Priest)

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Fixed order, repeating. Fights alongside 2 Kin Followers.

scaling: Priest +2 Strength every 4 turns; each Follower +2 every 3 turns.
threat: Three enemies. The Followers are Minions: they leave when the Priest dies.
Killing the Priest ends the fight; Followers have 58–59 HP each.

general: Choice to weigh: focus the Priest (ends everything) or reduce incoming damage by killing Followers first.

name: Kin Follower

powers.name: Minion
powers.text: Leaves combat when its leader dies.

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Fixed order. The two Followers are offset.

threat: Low damage alone; their Strength adds up in a long fight.

name: Vantom

powers.name: Slippery 9
powers.text: The next 9 times it loses HP, it only loses 1 HP instead. The wiki says each hit uses up a stack even if fully blocked.

moves.name: Dismember
moves.text: 27 damage, shuffles 3 Wounds into your discard pile

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Fixed order, repeating.

threat: Dismember lands on turns 3, 7, 11 — the big Block turns.
Slippery absorbs your first 9 hits. Many small hits strip it; a big hit early is mostly wasted.

defect: Lightning passives strip Slippery between your attacks.
regent: Strip Slippery before committing a big Sovereign Blade hit.
ironclad: Exhaust clears the Wounds from Dismember.

checkNote: Wiki text says 'Slippery 9 (8 at lower Ascensions)' — the ascension split looks wrong; confirm the number in game.

name: Corpse Slug

powers.name: Ravenous 4
powers.text: When another enemy dies, it eats it: becomes Stunned and gains 4 Strength (5 at A9).

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Fixed order. Each slug starts on a different move.

scaling: +4 Strength each time a slug eats a dead ally.
threat: Killing one slug buffs the others (but stuns them for a turn).

general: Spreading damage and killing slugs on the same turn limits Ravenous stacking.

name: Seapunk

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Fixed order, repeating.

scaling: +1 Strength every 3 turns (Spinning Kick gains 4 per Strength).
threat: Steady; Spinning Kick grows fastest with Strength.

name: Sludge Spinner

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Opens with Oil Spray.
Then random. Never the same move twice.

threat: Attacks every turn; Weak reduces your damage.

name: Toadpole

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Fixed order. In the weak encounter the front Toadpole starts with Spiken.

threat: Thorns: attacking it after Spiken costs you HP per hit. Multi-hit attacks are worst then.

name: Calcified Cultist

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Incantation, then Dark Strike every turn. No Strength on the Incantation turn.

threat: Clock enemy: every turn alive is +2 damage.

name: Damp Cultist

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Incantation, then Dark Strike every turn. No Strength on the Incantation turn.

threat: Starts harmless, overtakes the Calcified Cultist around turn 4.
checkNote: Ascension values unreadable on the wiki; base values look right.

name: Living Fog

powers.name: Smoggy (on you)
powers.text: You can only play 1 Skill per turn.

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Advanced Gas, then alternates Bloat / Super Gas Blast.

scaling: A new Gas Bomb every other turn.
threat: Smoggy limits you to 1 Skill a turn — Block-heavy hands suffer.
Gas Bombs explode for 8 the turn after they appear unless killed.

name: Gas Bomb

powers.name: Minion
powers.text: Leaves combat when its leader dies.

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Explodes on its turn.

threat: 7 HP to stop 8 damage.

name: Fossil Stalker

powers.name: Suck 3
powers.text: Whenever it deals unblocked attack damage, it gains 3 Strength.

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Opens with Latch.
Then random, equal chance. Can repeat.

scaling: +3 Strength per unblocked attack (possibly per unblocked hit — Lash hits twice).
threat: Full Block matters more here than anywhere else in the act. Frail makes that harder.

name: Gremlin Merc

powers.name: Thievery 20
powers.text: Steals 20 Gold when attacking.

powers.name: Surprise
powers.text: Summons Fat Gremlin and Sneaky Gremlin when it dies.

phases.name: Merc alive
rules: Fixed order, repeating.

threat: Every attack steals Gold. The Fat Gremlin carries it and flees — kill it to get the Gold back.

name: Fat Gremlin

powers.name: Heist
powers.text: When killed, returns all the stolen Gold.

phases.name: After Merc dies
rules: One turn to kill it before it flees.

threat: You have one turn to get your Gold back.

name: Sneaky Gremlin

phases.name: After Merc dies
rules: Idle first turn, then Tackle every turn.

threat: Competes with the Fat Gremlin for your damage on the free turn.

name: Haunted Ship

moves.name: Haunt
moves.text: Shuffles 5 Dazed into your discard pile, applies 3 Weak

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Haunt, then alternates Swipe / Stomp.

threat: 5 Dazed and 3 Weak up front slow your damage for the rest of the fight.

name: Punch Construct

powers.name: Artifact 1
powers.text: Negates the next debuff applied to it.

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Fixed order, repeating.

threat: Frail on turn 2, then 14 on turn 3 — your Block is weakest when the big hit lands.

name: Sewer Clam

powers.name: Plating 8
powers.text: Gains Block at end of its turn; Plating drops by 1 each turn. (9 at A8)

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Jet, then alternates Pressurize / Jet.

threat: Plating makes chip damage poor; fast scaling makes a long fight costly.

name: Two-Tailed Rat

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Turn 1: one rat each uses Scratch, Disease Bite, Screech.
Then random. Never the same move twice.
From turn 3, a rat may Call for Backup: each rat once, 3 summons max in total.

threat: Killing rats before turn 3 limits how many can summon.

name: Skulking Colony

powers.name: Hardened Shell 20
powers.text: Cannot lose more than 20 HP each turn. Resets at the start of your turn and of its turn.

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Fixed order, repeating.

threat: Minimum 4 turns to kill (75 HP ÷ 20 per turn) unless you have damage outside your turn.
It attacks every turn, so this is a Block check more than a damage check.

general: Overkill in one turn is wasted — spread damage across turns.
silent: The wiki notes Poison ticks on its turn, adding up to 20 more damage per round (40 total).
regent: A huge single hit is capped at 20 — it gains little here.

name: Phantasmal Gardener (×4)

powers.name: Skittish 6
powers.text: The first time it is hit each turn, it gains 6 Block (7 at A8).

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: All four share the cycle, offset by position (left to right).

threat: Four enemies with small HP. Skittish means your first hit on each one per turn is partly blocked.
Skittish triggers after the first Attack resolves (between Replays).

general: Area damage hits all four but triggers Skittish on all four too — the follow-up hits do full damage.

name: Terror Eel

powers.name: Shriek 70
powers.text: When its HP drops to 70, it is Stunned, then uses Terror. (75 at A8)

phases.name: Above 70 HP
rules: Alternates, starting with Crash.

phases.name: After Shriek (≤ 70 HP)
rules: Stunned, then Terror (99 Vulnerable — +50% damage taken for the rest of the fight), then back to Crash / Thrash.

scaling: Vigor (next attack bonus) from Thrash makes the following Crash bigger.
threat: After Terror, Crash hits for 24+ and you take 50% more from everything.
Stun and Terror are two enemy turns with no attack: that gives you two turns to deal the last 70 HP before the first Crash lands on 99 Vulnerable.

regent: Big single hits help burst the second 70 HP.
necrobinder: Doom stacked before the threshold can finish it after Terror.

name: Waterfall Giant

powers.name: Steam Eruption
powers.text: Stored steam. When it would die with Steam Eruption, it becomes invulnerable, then explodes for that amount next turn.

moves.name: Explode
moves.text: Damage equal to stored Steam Eruption, then dies

phases.name: Main fight
rules: Pressurize, then Stomp, Ram, Siphon, Pressure Gun, Pressure Up, repeating.

phases.name: After lethal damage
phases.trigger: Reduced to 0 HP with Steam Eruption
rules: About To Blow (invulnerable), then Explode next turn — you get one turn to Block.

scaling: Steam: 15 + 3 per turn after turn 1. Pressure Gun: 20, 25, 30…
threat: The fight ends with a final hit equal to stored Steam (e.g. about 45 on turn 11). Keep Block for it.
Siphon heals every 5th turn.

general: A quicker kill means a smaller explosion.
necrobinder: The wiki notes a Doom kill skips the explosion entirely.

name: Soul Fysh

moves.name: Beckon
moves.text: Shuffles 2 Beckon into your deck (1 draw pile, 1 discard)

phases.name: Whole fight
rules: Fixed 5-turn order, repeating.

scaling: Beckon cards accumulate: 3 more every cycle.
threat: Beckon (status): lose 6 HP at end of turn if it is in your hand.
Fade on turns 4, 9, 14: your damage on the following turn is mostly wasted (Intangible).
Scream follows Fade: 3 Vulnerable just before De-Gas comes round again.

general: Plan big damage turns around the Intangible turn, not into it.
silent: Discard moves Beckon out of your hand before end of turn.
necrobinder: The wiki notes Doom gets around Intangible.

name: Lagavulin Matriarch

powers.name: Plating 12
powers.text: Gains Block at end of its turn; drops by 1 each turn. Lost when it wakes.

powers.name: Asleep 3
powers.text: Wakes on losing HP or after 3 turns.

moves.name: Soul Siphon
moves.text: You lose 2 Strength and 2 Dexterity; it gains 2 Strength

phases.name: Asleep
rules: Up to 3 turns. Wakes early if it loses HP (damage must get through Plating Block).

phases.name: Awake
phases.trigger: Takes HP damage or 3 turns pass
rules: Loses all Plating, then Slash, Disembowel, Slash (2), Soul Siphon, repeating.

scaling: Soul Siphon every 4th awake turn: it +2 Strength, you −2 Strength and −2 Dexterity.
threat: Up to 3 free turns to set up — but waking it early skips the rest of them.
Soul Siphon permanently shrinks your Strength and Dexterity: a long fight hurts both your attack and your Block.

general: Whether to set up (Powers, Block) during the sleep or wake it early is the key decision.
